items.question: Donne toutes les combinaisons possibles de trois médicaments différents.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m1.cis AS cis1, m2.cis AS cis2, m3.cis AS cis3
FROM medicaments m1
JOIN medicaments m2 ON m2.cis != m1.cis
JOIN medicaments m3 ON m3.cis != m1.cis AND m3.cis != m2.cis

items.question: Croise chaque composition avec chaque présentation de chaque autre médicament et compte les lignes obtenues.
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_lignes
FROM (
  SELECT c1.cis AS cis1, c1.substance AS substance1, p.cis AS cis2, p.libelle AS libelle2
  FROM compositions c1
  JOIN presentations p ON p.cis = c1.cis
  JOIN medicaments m ON m.cis = c1.cis
  JOIN compositions c2 ON c2.cis = m.cis
  JOIN presentations p2 ON p2.cis = m.cis
  WHERE c1.nature_composant = 'SA' AND c2.nature_composant = 'SA'
    AND c1.cis != m.cis
)
